name: Soril
summary: Soril is wrapped in light grey matte elm veneer, giving the body a clean, refined warmth. The back panels are finished with silver mirror, adding a subtle reflective depth enhanced by a sleek LED light strip that gives the piece a quiet, atmospheric glow. Brass brushed plated stainless steel hinges elevate the detailing with a tailored metallic richness. The base, finished in brass metallic paint, grounds the design with a warm, polished presence. The whole piece feels modern, composed and unmistakably upscale. the body cover with elm veneer in light grey matt back panels cover with 5mm silver mirror. with LED light strip. The stainless steel door hinge plating in brass brushed color, the base paint in brass metallic. 113x51x148
